chunks: Say: 'Surely if men and jinns get together to produce the like of this (Qur'an), they will not be able to produce the like of it, however they might assist one another.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the ability of humans and jinn to replicate its text?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited alongside the concept of *I'jaz* to highlight the Quran's linguistic and spiritual depth, which transcends human and jinn capabilities. It underscores the divine authority of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and serves as a foundational argument for the Quran's uncreated nature and eternal truth. The mention of 'mutual support' (*zahiran*) emphasizes that even combined efforts of all creation cannot replicate its unique structure and meaning.
